entity.name: Hitoshi Yamamoto
entity.description: Author and sole maintainer of irekey, an open-source Go tool for managing the same software on many offline embedded Linux devices, where every customer needs small local differences, with delivery over SSH and automatic rollback.

projects.name: irekey
projects.description: irekey manages the same software running on many offline embedded Linux computers, where every customer needs small local differences, and delivers changes over SSH with automatic rollback. It is designed to record what each device really runs, keep each customer's adjustments as reviewed configuration layers and patch stacks on top of one base, and deliver signed bundles that roll back unless the operator confirms them, with nothing running permanently on the devices. Early development: the design is specified and the repository foundation is being built; there is no release yet. MIT licensed.
